title: Three Weeks and One Short Case
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：instrument　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 instrument 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the researcher ① read the instrument that no student in the laboratory would have recorded, and he said the reading was the whole of the week. The ② instrument, meaning the tool itself and not the case, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a instrument, he said, is the only thing in a laboratory that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ instrument in that laboratory had the same short case beside it, and the ④ instrument at the far shelf, meaning the reading they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A instrument, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the researcher said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the instrument was the whole of the matter, meaning the evidence and not the tool. The ⑥ instrument, meaning the evidence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; instrument, he said, is either something you read or the only word that means both a tool and a evidence. He said the evidence is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ instrument had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short case. The ⑧ instrument of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in April, was one laboratory and three weeks of recording; instrument, he said, is either the reading at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ instrument I remember is the tool recorded in the journal, which closed in 2003 and is still recorded as the quietest in the laboratory. A ⑩ instrument, my mother said in 2005, is the only tool that improves by being recorded; every instrument, she said, is a evidence that has agreed to look like a tool. She said the evidence was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 仪器；器具（指实验室里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 仪器；器具（指那件仪器本身，与盒子相对）
C. 固定搭配：read the instrument 读取这件仪器

F. n. 仪器；器具（指实验日志里写到、被记下的的那一件）
G. n. 证据、依据（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: read the instrument 意为“读取这件仪器”，1996 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位研究生肯记录的一件仪器做了一遍。
instrument 意为“仪器；器具”，指那件仪器本身而不是盒子，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
instrument 意为“仪器；器具”，指实验室里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一个小小的盒子。
instrument 意为“仪器；器具”，指最远那列架旁留给孩子们照着记的一个那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
instrument 意为“证据、依据”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条证据就是那件事的全部。
instrument 意为“依据”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件仪器，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
instrument 意为“仪器；器具”，指实验日志里写到、被记下的的那一件，到 2001 年这一件成了实验日志里的一行。
instrument 意为“实验之事”，研究员四月写道，整件事的仪器之事是一处实验室和三个星期的记录。
instrument 意为“仪器；器具”，我记得的是实验日志里记录过的那一件，2003 年校准了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一件。
instrument 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，仪器是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的仪器。
